mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which typically precedes higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market and robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a synchronized expansion in demand and supply, which typically results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both RSAFS and INDPRO increase, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 typically underperforms due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity, producing negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) indicates a strengthening economy and higher nominal growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL increases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300.0 thousand units, it signals a robust housing market and strong consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1300.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and fall in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong economy with improving labor conditions, which typically results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In recessionary regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the S&P 500 typically underperforms due to weak corporate earnings and economic uncertainty, producing negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
